groups.defect: ProvideAnonDBStore gains an int64 parameter while its Wire registration remains unchanged, leaving Wire unable to supply the argument.
groups.rationale: All three report the same constructor and provider-registration mismatch and propose equivalent fixes.

groups.defect: Caching a device before its database write succeeds leaves rejected devices cached, allowing subsequent requests to bypass the device limit.
groups.rationale: The suggestions point to the cache/write sequence and the calling error-propagation path, but all report the same retained cache entry after failure. Changing cache insertion to occur only after a successful write resolves all three.
